t_advice_summary_textbox.text: The gnomes colour combinations always appear the same. 0-9 mushrooms are given out by each gnome. Try to select the gnome which consistenly gives you the most mushrooms to earn more points. Foe example the gnome pointing to the left seems to give the multiple of 5.

vb_textbox.text: The gnomes appear in different height and colour combinations.Each gnome gives out between 0-9 mushrooms.The game seems to notice if you select the best gnome too many times and so switches which is the highest paying gnome.Have Fun :)
